videos.title: How To Stand Out In A World Of AI Designs
videos.description:
Magic Patterns (W23) is one of the fastest-growing design tools in AI, helping product teams turn ideas into interactive, code-backed prototypes in minutes.

Alex Danilowicz and his co-founder, both front-end engineers, built 
Magic Patterns to solve a problem they had themselves: finding a better way to turn ideas into something visual. They were among the first teams building prompt-to-design tools back in 2023.

In this episode of Design Review, Alex joins YC’s Aaron Epstein to demo Magic Patterns and its new MagicOS canvas, where teams can bring together prompts, images, PRDs, and other context to explore ideas visually. Then they review a handful of startup websites to break down what makes a site feel “vibe coded,” where founders go wrong, and how to make AI-generated design feel more intentional.

So, From JioBharat phones to JioSaavn to JioFiber, Jio sells a dozen different things in all kinds of markets!!
So question is,
How does this business actually make money?

videos.title: President Zelenskyy: It's Time To Tell You The Truth About The War! They Found 500 Bodies!
videos.description:
What does it truly cost a human being to lead a nation through an existential war while the world watches from afar? President Volodymyr Zelenskyy reveals the psychological toll of continuous survival, the grim realities of geopolitical negotiation, and what keeps him still standing.

Volodymyr Zelenskyy is the President of Ukraine, having led the nation through its darkest historical hours following the full-scale Russian invasion in 2022. A former lawyer, comedian, and actor turned wartime leader, he transitioned from satirical television to the global stage. His current administration focuses on securing Ukraine's sovereignty, managing international diplomacy, and defending democratic freedom against imperial aggression.

In this episode, he explains:
■ The Burden of Command: How constant psychological pressure and nightly military briefings push his endurance to its limits under relentless wartime pressure.
■ The Fatal Miscalculation: Why Russia's catastrophic military mistake came from a failure to recognize Ukrainians as a distinct people willing to fight for their freedom.
■ The Turning Point of Atrocity: How witnessing the aftermath of war in liberated towns transformed a political conflict into deeply personal tragedy where easy forgiveness became impossible.
■ The Cost of Staying: Why the refusal to evacuate Kyiv was driven by the absolute need to remain visible and prevent the nation from surrendering out of fear.
■ The Geopolitical Reality: How true diplomatic peace requires holding aggressive regimes fully accountable for their crimes rather than shifting the blame onto global energy markets.

This episode was recorded on October 16, 2026. The English audio for President Zelenskyy uses AI voice technology, with permission, based on human translation and editorial review. For President Zelenskky's original Ukrainian audio: Settings ⚙️ → Audio track → English (US).

In today’s episode, we sit down with Ayyoub “Ello” El Osrouti, Professional Athlete and Ultrarunner, to discuss how he went from barely running to competing at an elite level in just four years.

We discuss why he stopped after running over 620 km in a Backyard Ultra, how he trained his mind to tolerate extreme pain, and what he learned from David Goggins about discipline, mental toughness, and pushing beyond his limits. Ello breaks down his 7-day training routine, what he eats during a 93-hour race, the supplements he takes for recovery, and how he balances physical limitations with his drive to keep going.

The conversation also explores how he deals with the urge to quit, why he focuses on one loop at a time instead of the total distance, how visualization helped shape his ambitions, and his practical advice for anyone looking to build mental strength, get out of their comfort zone, and change their life.
